quest.title: Our Animal Friends
quest.description: The Feiyun Guild is on the move, taking on social responsibilities and promoting harmonious symbiosis between humanity and nature!
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Inscribed Mirror x1

talks.objective: Talk to the Feiyun Commerce Guild staff

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: All are welcome to join the "Claw Convoy" animal rescue society...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, it's you. How do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Our guild is currently holding an event. Might that interest you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of event are we talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Simply put, we're asking people to join the Claw Convoy, an animal rescue society sponsored by the Feiyun Commerce Guild, and help us take care of abandoned or endangered animals.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: The Guild has been working with volunteers from the various nations, helping to solve the widespread problem of stray animals through communal adoption.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: We've seen major expansion in recent years, which led us to start thinking about working with researchers like Ms. Lamiya in the field of endangered animal conservation.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Honestly, I'm glad to see my research bear fruit in this way too.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Haha! Then we're of the same mind.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Thanks to our volunteers and visionary researchers like Ms. Lamiya, many stray animals now have a home, and endangered species are being protected.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Aside from Liyue, the Claw Convoy's animal care facilities may be found everywhere the Feiyun Commerce Guild is active, like in Mondstadt and Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: As such, we're running this event to show our gratitude to our volunteers and to let everyone know just how many Convoy companions we've got out there.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: You can head over to the area where the adopted animals are staying to check on their actual living conditions, and take a small gift to go.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: The gifts were prepared by our staff and other animal adopters. Of course, before you claim a gift, you'll need to prepare something for other adopters as well.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: When the time comes, all gifts will be retrieved by a professional and delivered to the original adopter. No need for expensive gifts — they're just meant to convey your feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: #So how about it, {NICKNAME}? Interested?

choices.text: Sure, I'll give it a go.

response.speaker: Zhenchen
response.text: Wonderful! It would be amazing to have a celebrity like you taking part.

response.speaker: Zhenchen
response.text: If you're ready, you can hand over your gift now. Our staff will pass it to the relevant adopter once the event ends.

response.speaker: Zhenchen
response.text: By the way, based on my personal experience, some of our adopters are interested in regional specialties, and others prefer good food.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: How about you split your gift into two boxes?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Okay, we'll pack these specialties into a gift box.

talks.objective: Talk to the Feiyun Commerce Guild staff

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll pack this food into a box and send it out.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Each animal behaves in its own unique way. We don't lock them away in cages. Instead, we employ professional caretakers to monitor their physical condition.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Tracking them down is no easy task. You'll need the special Inscribed Tracker that Ms. Lamiya has developed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: I'm not as knowledgeable as she is in this area, so I'll leave the explaining to her.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Agreed. Allow me to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: The underlying tech behind the Inscribed Mirror is related to the Akasha, and the operational specifics are quite complex, but don't worry, it's tested and safe.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: We've already attached micro-transmitters to all the animals, so we just need to read the device's signal, and the mirror will reveal all that can be seen from the animal's perspective.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: This device may need some improvements, but this footage will suffice for us to locate active animals.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: That's all there is to it. If you're ready, then we're happy to welcome you to the Claw Convoy!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenchen
dialogues.text: Use the Inscribed Mirror to find our animal friends. Both our adopters' gifts and the animals themselves will be waiting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Maybe I should adopt an animal too? If only I could keep a Rishboland Tiger...
